Section 8.3 Notices. All notices and other communications given or made pursuant hereto shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been duly given or made (a) as of the date delivered if delivered personally or as of the date sent if sent by email (notice deemed given upon transmission so long as there is no return error message or other notification of non-delivery received by the sender) and (b) on the next Business Day if sent by prepaid overnight carrier (providing proof of delivery), to the parties at the following addresses (or at such other addresses as shall be specified by the parties by like notice):
